description:
In this clip from our fireside chat, Dave Morin explains why OpenClaw feels like the Linux of AI. Unlike traditional AI chatbots that only allow minor customizations on top, OpenClaw provides a deep, extensible framework that developers can truly build on. From tweaking core components to architecting substantial applications, it opens up new possibilities for open source software. Watch the full fireside chat on the GitHub channel to learn more.
